optSubtitle.description: Options page subtitle: the section name

optPressKey.message: Press a key · Backspace clears · Esc undoes
optPressKey.description: Shortcut input placeholder: how to bind, how to clear, how to undo the current edit

optDuplicate.message: "$1" and "$2" are bound to the same key; each action needs a different key

optReserved.message: The browser already uses this key; pick another one
optReserved.description: Blocking error for a shortcut the browser reserves

actionIncreaseDesc.message: Increase playback speed (+0.1, hold to repeat)

actionDecreaseDesc.message: Decrease playback speed (-0.1, hold to repeat)

ctlGroup.description: Accessible name of the fullscreen control bar

ctlPause.description: Fullscreen control play button while the video is playing

ctlUnmute.description: Fullscreen control mute button while muted

ctlMuted.description: Fullscreen control volume slider while muted

ctlSpeed.description: Fullscreen control speed button; the current rate is appended to it

hintFullscreen.description: First-run hint: the fullscreen shortcut toggles page fullscreen

hintSpeedTiny.description: Tiny hint (third fallback for very small embed frames): action name squeezed to one word, keys listed bare. What is dropped is the **direction** ("faster / slower / back to 1x"), not "what these three keys do" — bare `= / - / 0` does not tell the user it is speed control. Measured: fits on one line at 166px content width

hintFullscreenTiny.description: Tiny hint, fullscreen line (third fallback). Full version is "Press $1 to toggle page fullscreen" — wraps to 2 lines at 166px content width; this one fits on one line

hintMore.message: All shortcuts can be rebound in the extension settings (right-click the extension icon → Options)
hintMore.description: First-run hint: footer line, tells the user where the settings live

actionTitle.description: Toolbar icon title prefix; the current speed is appended to it

noticeCannotTakeOver.message: This video can't be controlled here for now
noticeCannotTakeOver.description: Shown when the page fullscreen player cannot control a video

speedChanged.description: Screen reader announcement when the playback rate changes

speedCurrent.description: Visually hidden text a screen reader user can read at any time to find out the current playback rate

optPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the options page

optLead.message: Every action can be rebound. Press Backspace / Delete in the field to clear the binding and disable that action, and press Esc to undo the change you just made; changes apply to open tabs immediately. These keys only work while a video is playing in the page — pressing them on a page with no video does nothing.
optLead.description: Options page lead paragraph: how to rebind, how to clear, how to undo, and the fact that the keys only act on videos that are playing in the page

commandOpenOptions.description: Browser command: opens the extension options page

__vscLocale.description: Language marker: lets the extension know which locale directory Chrome actually selected (read via chrome.i18n.getMessage). Do not translate — it is a BCP 47 tag.

noticeNoVideo.message: There is no video on this page
noticeNoVideo.description: Shown when the user clicks the toolbar icon on a page that has no video

noticeVideoElsewhere.message: Video is in an embedded frame — click it to use the shortcuts
noticeVideoElsewhere.description: Shown when a shortcut did nothing because the video lives in another frame (an embedded player)

extensionDescription.message: Minimal keyboard shortcuts and a clean page-fullscreen player that only controls the video you are watching
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions

optDisabled.description: Placeholder shown when an action has no shortcut

optUnsaved.description: Status line shown while the form differs from the saved shortcuts

optRestored.description: Status line shown after "Restore defaults" was written to storage

optSelfConflict.message: This key is one of the extension's own commands; pick another one
optSelfConflict.description: Blocking error for a shortcut that collides with the extension's own command

optTipsToolbar.message: Click the toolbar icon to toggle page fullscreen
optTipsToolbar.description: Options page hint: the toolbar icon toggles fullscreen

optTipsOptions.message: Press $1 to open the settings page
optTipsOptions.description: Options page hint: the shortcut that opens the settings page

hintToolbar.message: In fullscreen, click the speed button for presets (0.5x–4x)
hintToolbar.description: First-run hint: the fullscreen control bar has a clickable speed menu. 原来写的是「点扩展图标可切换网页全屏」—— 那与同一张卡片里的第一行（按 f 切换网页全屏）说的是同一件事，等于把一行浪费在复述上

playbackPlaying.description: Screen reader announcement after the video starts playing

playbackPaused.description: Screen reader announcement after the video pauses

seekForward.description: Screen reader announcement after seeking forward

seekBack.description: Screen reader announcement after seeking backward

positionMinutes.description: Playback position in minutes and seconds (used inside the seek announcements)

positionSeconds.description: Playback position in seconds (used inside the seek announcements)

fullscreenEntered.description: Screen reader announcement after entering page fullscreen

fullscreenExited.description: Screen reader announcement after leaving page fullscreen

optionFirstRunHintTitle.description: Options page: title of the row that reopens the first-run guide

optionResetFirstRunHintDesc.message: The guide appears only once. Reset it here and it shows up again the next time you are on a page with a video — tabs that are already open pick it up too, no refresh needed.
optionResetFirstRunHintDesc.description: Options page: explains what the reopen-guide button does

optionResetFirstRunHint.description: Options page: button that clears the first-run guide state so the guide can appear again

optionResetFirstRunHintDone.description: Options page: confirmation shown after the first-run guide state was cleared

optionResetFirstRunHintFailed.message: Could not reset the guide, please try again
optionResetFirstRunHintFailed.description: Options page: error shown when clearing the first-run guide state failed

optDuplicateRow.description: Inline error shown under the conflicting shortcut field: which action it clashes with, and which key

hintClose.description: First-run hint: the close button of the guide

optionFirstRunHintFailed.message: Closed $1 time(s) (close it $2 more time(s) and it will stay away for a while)
optionFirstRunHintFailed.description: Options page: how many times the guide has been closed on purpose

optionFirstRunHintCooldown.description: Options page: the guide is in its cooldown period

extensionInactive.message: The extension is no longer active on this page. Refresh this page. If the extension is disabled, re-enable it from the extensions page.
extensionInactive.description: Shown when the extension context is invalidated (updated, reloaded, or disabled): this page still runs the old, dead content script. The wording must hold for all three causes — a page cannot tell them apart (measured: chrome.* behaves identically after an update and after a disable).

refreshThisPage.description: Suffix in the toolbar icon title: this tab was opened before the extension was installed, so it only takes effect after a refresh

noticeAmbientPreview.message: This is a page preview — click it, or click the extension icon, to control it

optLoadFailed.message: Could not read your settings — your shortcuts were left untouched. Please retry reading.
optLoadFailed.description: Options page: reading storage failed. The page must say so instead of silently showing the defaults

optRetryLoad.description: Options page: retry reading the settings after a failed read

optLoadOk.description: Options page: the settings were read successfully after a retry

optUndoRestore.description: Options page: the "Restore defaults" button turns into an undo for a few seconds after a restore

optRestoreUndone.description: Options page: the restore-defaults was undone and the previous bindings are back

hintSpeedReset.description: First-run hint: speed step actions plus the reset key. 复位必须教 —— 全屏之外没有别的出口能回到 1x（胶囊与角标都是 pointer-events: none；倍速菜单只在全屏控制条里；manifest 无 contextMenus 权限）。它与快/慢并成**同一行**而不是另起一行：完整版 4 行 / 精简版 2 行是这套代码的承重不变式（阅读窗口、高度预算、测试高度桩都锁在它上面）
